entry.title: New: Resolution 540 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 540-26 - 04/22/26
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT FOR THE HAWAI‘I POLICE DEPARTMENT TO PURCHASE MISCELLANEOUS EQUIPMENT FOR USE BY COMMUNITY POLICING AND HI-PAL

Transfers $4,796.32 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 3)
